# Combine both bin sizes into one long table
```{r}
metrics <- bind_rows(
  bp50  %>% mutate(bin_size = "50 bp"),
  bp100 %>% mutate(bin_size = "100 bp")
) %>%
  mutate(
    bin_size = factor(bin_size, levels = c("50 bp", "100 bp")),
    # guard: samples with empty fields make read.csv return character columns
    across(c(MEDIAN_LENGTH, MEAN_LENGTH, NUM_REGIONS), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(MEDIAN_LENGTH, MEAN_LENGTH, NUM_REGIONS),
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)  # drops samples with empty/NA metrics
  ) %>%    
  filter(!sample %in% low_read$sample)  # drops samples with low read depth

# per-metric, per-bin summary statistics used for the annotations
metric_stats <- metrics %>%
  group_by(metric, bin_size) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = mean(value),
    median = median(value),
    sd     = sd(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
metric_stats
```

# Summary statistics: 50 bp vs 100 bp
```{r}
# full descriptive table (mean, sd, se, CV, quartiles, range) per metric x bin size
summary_stats <- metrics %>%
  group_by(metric, bin_size) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = mean(value),
    sd     = sd(value),
    se     = sd(value) / sqrt(n()),
    cv_pct = 100 * sd(value) / mean(value),
    min    = min(value),
    q1     = quantile(value, 0.25),
    median = median(value),
    q3     = quantile(value, 0.75),
    max    = max(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(n), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  arrange(metric, bin_size)

summary_stats

# compact "mean ± sd" view, one row per metric
summary_stats %>%
  mutate(`mean ± sd` = paste0(format(mean, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
                              " ± ", format(sd, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE))) %>%
  select(metric, bin_size, n, `mean ± sd`, median) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = bin_size, values_from = c(n, `mean ± sd`, median))
```

# Density histogram function
```{r}
plot_metric <- function(which_metric, x_lab, digits = 0,
                        dat = metrics, stat_tbl = metric_stats) {

  d <- filter(dat, metric == which_metric)
  s <- filter(stat_tbl, metric == which_metric)

  # multi-line stats label, one line per bin size
  stat_label <- paste0(
    s$bin_size, ": mean = ", format(round(s$mean, digits), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
    ", median = ", format(round(s$median, digits), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
    " (n = ", s$n, ")",
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  ggplot(d, aes(x = value, fill = bin_size, colour = bin_size)) +
    geom_histogram(
      aes(y = after_stat(density)),
      bins = 30, position = "identity",
      alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0
    ) +
    geom_density(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(
      data = s, aes(xintercept = mean, colour = bin_size),
      linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", direction = -1, begin = 0.15, end = 0.75) +
    scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "plasma", direction = -1, begin = 0.15, end = 0.75) +
    labs(
      title  = NULL,
      x      = x_lab,
      y      = "Density",
      fill   = "Bin size",
      colour = "Bin size"
    ) +
    # extra headroom so the annotation never collides with the density curves
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.22))) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3,
      label = stat_label,
      size = 2.5, lineheight = 1.15
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
      axis.line       = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks      = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "black"),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm")
    )
}
```

```{r}
frip50 <-  read.csv("FRIP_50_scraped.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
head(frip50)
frip100 <-  read.csv("FRIP_100_scraped.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
head(frip100)
```

# Combine FRIP scores from both bin sizes
```{r}
# header in these files is "sample<TAB>FRIP score", so read.csv names it
# FRIP.score - select by position to stay robust to that
frip <- bind_rows(
  frip50  %>% mutate(bin_size = "50 bp"),
  frip100 %>% mutate(bin_size = "100 bp")
) %>%
  rename(FRIP = 2) %>%
  mutate(
    bin_size = factor(bin_size, levels = c("50 bp", "100 bp")),
    FRIP     = as.numeric(FRIP)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = FRIP, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))          # drops samples with empty/NA FRIP

frip_stats <- frip %>%
  group_by(metric, bin_size) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = mean(value),
    median = median(value),
    sd     = sd(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
frip_stats
```

```{r}
  select(bin_size, n, `mean ± sd`, median, min, max)
```

# Paired comparison of FRIP between bin sizes
```{r}
frip_paired <- frip %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = bin_size, values_from = value,
              names_prefix = "bin_") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`bin_50 bp`), !is.na(`bin_100 bp`)) %>%
  mutate(diff = `bin_50 bp` - `bin_100 bp`)

frip_tests <- frip_paired %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs    = n(),
    mean_50    = mean(`bin_50 bp`),
    sd_50      = sd(`bin_50 bp`),
    mean_100   = mean(`bin_100 bp`),
    sd_100     = sd(`bin_100 bp`),
    mean_diff  = mean(diff),
    sd_diff    = sd(diff),
    pct_change = 100 * mean(diff) / mean(`bin_100 bp`),  # 50 bp vs 100 bp
    t_p        = t.test(`bin_50 bp`, `bin_100 bp`, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
    wilcox_p   = wilcox.test(`bin_50 bp`, `bin_100 bp`, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
    cohens_dz  = mean(diff) / sd(diff),                  # paired effect size
    r_pearson  = cor(`bin_50 bp`, `bin_100 bp`)          # agreement between bins
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(n_pairs), ~ signif(.x, 3)))

frip_tests
```
